name: Customer signal to roadmap
outcome: Traceable customer observations produce a checked, evidence-ranked roadmap proposal.

verifier.green_means: Every recommended roadmap item traces to customer evidence and states confidence and disconfirming evidence.

stop.success: The product council checker accepts the evidence-ranked proposal.

nodes.name: Collect customer observations
nodes.outcome: Customer statements and behaviors are recorded with source provenance and consent boundaries.

contract.goal: Create a source-linked set of customer observations without converting assumptions into facts.

verifier.green_means: Each observation is source-linked, redacted where required, and separated from inference.

stop.success: The evidence auditor accepts the observation set.

nodes.name: Identify repeated pain patterns
nodes.outcome: Repeated pains are ranked with supporting and disconfirming observations.

contract.goal: Rank repeated customer pains without hiding weak or contradictory evidence.

verifier.green_means: Each pattern has traceable support, confidence, and explicit disconfirming evidence.

stop.success: The research critic accepts the ranked pattern map.

nodes.name: Propose the next roadmap moves
nodes.outcome: A narrow roadmap proposal ties each move to a customer pattern and learning test.

contract.goal: Translate accepted customer patterns into reversible roadmap proposals with learning gates.

verifier.green_means: Every proposal names its evidence, confidence, learning test, owner, and stop condition.

stop.success: The product council checker accepts the roadmap proposal.
